parameters.label: Audio Encoding
parameters.helpText: Runtime value for query {"$var":"encoding"} and request {"$path":"config.audio.encoding"}. The backend validates references before the provider starts.
parameters.errorMessage: Please select a valid audio encoding for custom STT.

parameters.label: Sample Rate
parameters.helpText: Runtime value for query {"$var":"sample_rate"} and request {"$path":"config.audio.sample_rate"}. Use {"$cast":"number","value":...} when the upstream expects a number.
parameters.errorMessage: Please select a valid sample rate for custom STT.

parameters.label: Query Parameters
parameters.helpText: Optional flat JSON object appended to the credential URL. Runtime variables are {"$var":"model"}, {"$var":"language"}, {"$var":"encoding"}, and {"$var":"sample_rate"}. Values must resolve to string, number, or boolean.
parameters.errorMessage: Please provide valid query parameters for custom STT.

parameters.label: Request Rules
parameters.helpText: Ordered request rules for packets turn_change, audio, and interrupt. send.body may use {"$path":"config.model"}, config.language, config.audio.encoding, config.audio.sample_rate, packet.context_id, and packet.audio bytes/base64/pcm_base64/wav_base64. HTTP v1 uses only the first audio rule and requires send.frame "json".
parameters.errorMessage: Please provide valid request rules for custom STT.

parameters.label: Response Rules
parameters.helpText: Required response rule list. Match json or text frames and emit script, confidence, language, interim, or error using {"$path":"field.path"}; text frames may also use {"$frame":"text"}.
parameters.errorMessage: Please provide valid response rules for custom STT.
